DISCOVERY 612, PRESENT: NOAH W. KANTER, ESQ. FOR PLAINTIFF/MOVING PARTY, THECLA GLUECK. MARGARET M. LESNIAK, ESQ. FOR DEFENDANT/OPPOSING PARTY. HEARING HELD. RULING OF COURT AFTER HEARING: SPECIFIC OBJECTIONS OVERRULED AS TO CLAIMS OF PRIVILEGE, PRODUCE A PRIVILEGE LOG. PRODUCE AND RESPOND BY JANUARY 28, 2005. TENTATIVE OTHERWISE ADOPTED. (TENTATIVE RULING: PLAINTIFF'S MOTION TO COMPEL FURTHER RESPONSES AND COMPLIANCE WITH PRIOR RESPONSES FROM DEFENDANT TO PLAINTIFF'S REQUEST FOR PRODUCTION OF DOCUMENTS, SET ONE; REQUEST FOR ADMISSIONS, SET ONE; AND FORM INTERROGATORIES, SET TWO, IS GRANTED IN PART AND MOOT IN PART. AS TO THE REQUEST FOR PRODUCTION OF DOCUMENTS, DEFENDANT'S INTRODUCTORY STATEMENT AND GENERAL OBJECTIONS ARE OVERRULED AND ORDERED STRICKEN. THERE IS NO PROVISION FOR INTRODUCTORY STATEMENTS AND GENERAL OBJECTIONS IN THE CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE. AS THERE HAS BEEN A SUPPLEMENTAL PRODUCTION, THE COURT WILL NOT DETERMINE THE ADEQUACY OF THE PRODUCTION ON THIS MOTION. AS TO THE REQUESTS FOR ADMISSIONS, SET ONE; AND FORM INTERROGATORIES, SET TWO, THE MOTION IS GRANTED IN PART AND MOOT IN PART. THE PREAMBLE AND GENERAL OBJECTIONS ARE OVERRULED AND ORDERED STRICKEN. AS TO REQUEST FOR ADMISSION NO. 5, DEFENDANT IS ORDERED TO RESPOND FURTHER. THE COURT FINDS THAT THE PREAMBLES, GENERAL OBJECTIONS, AND THE LATE PRODUCTION OF DOCUMENTS WERE MISUSES OF THE DISCOVERY PROCESS. SANTIONS ARE IMPOSED AGAINST DEFENDANT IN THE AMOUNT OF $1,136.30, TO BE PAID WITHIN 30 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER). COMM: EVERETT A. HEWLETT
